name: sinister-mindreaver-decline-second-discard-opponent-still-draws-one
notes: Sinister Mindreaver On Champion Hit: player 2 discards one of player 1's memory cards and declines the second. 'They draw that many cards': player 1 draws one card into memory. Declining the second discard used to skip SinisterMindreaverPick2, which does the drawing, so player 1 drew nothing.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Sinister Mindreaver's optional-choice continuation (SinisterMindreaverPick2) handles the declined choice itself, but Core's ExecuteStaticMethods() skipped it on PASS (it was queued without dontSkipOnPass): the opponent never drew the card for the discard after the second discard was declined. Fix: Grand Archive registers the handler as decline-aware (GameCustomHandlerRunsOnPass, asked by Core before it skips) and the handler consumes the decline with ConsumeDeclinedChoice().
